title: Ancestry Catalogue
description: The real, complete SF2E ancestry catalogue (51 entries), extracted live from gamesystems/sf2e/packs/ancestries for the induction terminal's Page 2 (design/induction-terminal.md). No reflavoring -- this is the character's REAL ancestry, not the terrestrial disguise (project_induction_and_newcomers memory). Singleton file: data/campaign/ancestry-catalogue.json.

hp.description: Ancestry HP, before class HP and the Con modifier -- tools/character-builder/derive.mjs's deriveHP `ancestryHP` input.

boosts.description: One entry per boost slot, in Player Core's own order. A single-ability entry (e.g. ["con"]) is a fixed boost -- apply automatically, no player choice. A multi-ability entry is a free choice among exactly those abilities; core/induction-ancestry.mjs is what resolves a player's pick against this shape.

flaws.description: Same shape and resolution rule as boosts. An empty array means this ancestry has no flaw at all (a 'voluntary' ancestry, e.g. Human, Orc, Maraquoi, Dragonkin, Formian -- two free boosts, no flaw, per the remaster).

additionalLanguages.description: How many extra languages an Intelligence boost (or similar) can add from the ancestry's own list. Informational only -- the induction terminal does not yet let a player spend these (open question, design doc §7).

description.description: Real Player Core / Galactic Ancestries / Alien Core flavor text, HTML-stripped -- shown to players on Page 2. Trimmed, by deletion only, where SF2E's text assumes a later era than this campaign's: see sourceDescription and GitHub #203.

sourceDescription.description: SF2E's own description, verbatim, present only where description was trimmed for this campaign's era (GitHub #203, 2026-09-25): the words assuming the Gap has happened, the Pact Worlds exist, Golarion is lost or the Drift exists. Never shown to players; kept so the trim can be checked or undone.

terrestrial.description: This project's own tag, not an SF2E field (design/induction.md §2): is this one of Golarion's own peoples, so a character of it needs no disguise? True exactly when the ancestry is also a Pathfinder 2e ancestry (Ingram, 2026-09-26: 'If it wasn't a PF2E ancestry then it's an alien one'); the catalogue's own description lists them. Picking a non-terrestrial ancestry on Page 2 queues the alien-lockdown sub-flow (Page 6a) -- picking a terrestrial one does not.
